mn36:17.12: And if those ascetics and brahmins don’t suffer painful, sharp, severe, acute feelings due to exertion, they are still incapable of knowledge and vision, of supreme awakening.
mn36:21.6: In the same way, when I cut off my breathing through my mouth and nose, winds came out my ears making a loud noise.
mn36:22.6: In the same way, when I cut off my breathing through my mouth and nose and ears, strong winds ground my head.
mn36:23.6: In the same way, when I cut off my breathing through my mouth and nose and ears, I got a severe headache.
mn36:24.6: In the same way, when I cut off my breathing through my mouth and nose and ears, strong winds carved up my belly.
mn36:25.6: In the same way, when I cut off my breathing through my mouth and nose and ears, there was a severe burning in my body.
mn36:30.3: Whatever ascetics and brahmins will experience painful, sharp, severe, acute feelings due to exertion in the future, this is as far as it goes, no-one will do more than this.
mn36:30.4: Whatever ascetics and brahmins experience painful, sharp, severe, acute feelings due to exertion at present, this is as far as it goes, no-one does more than this.
mn36:48.18: The Longer Discourse With Saccaka is finished—the sixth.
